verdict.rationale: Make publishes an official MCP server on its Developer Hub. AI systems such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to it as MCP clients and get tools to run scenarios and manage the account (scenarios, connections, webhooks, data stores). Make Skills documentation also helps assistants connect to it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting and working through the server, and setup/auth detail for the MCP connection in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: AI systems like Claude and ChatGPT act as MCP clients of Make MCP server. The server provides them access to **scenario run** and **management** tools
Make MCP server allows AI systems, such as large language models (LLMs), to run scenarios and manage the contents of your Make account.
View and modify scenarios and their related entities (e.g., connections, webhooks, and data stores)
official MCP server documented at https://developers.make.com/mcp-server
